pattern.crimePattern: a land registrar orders the killing of the surveyor who refused to move his beacons; her messenger pays a mechanic and is driven to the road; twelve years later her desk is still in her study
pattern.notes: Fictional people, offices, companies and parcel; Lands House, Bahati and JKIA are settings only. Kivuli is Margaret Kabiru (name confirmed 2 November 2026; the cultural reader still reviews it). Fundi killed Joseph; Oduya (present and paying) and Pius (driving) are the two accomplices: the only case with two ACCOMPLICE groups. Kabiru is charged on the SPINE line, not the WHO blank: the desk never touches the bar.

facts.text: Twelve years ago Joseph Mwenda was found dead on the Bahati road verge; robbery suspected; the file was closed after nine days. Today it is reopened.
Mwalimu's note on the original file: "Not a robbery. Taken: his field book only."
His property list: a watch and KSh 2,400 in his shirt pocket, left on him. Only the wallet and the field book were gone.
The file's cover sheet lists the Lands House officers of twelve years ago: Chief Land Registrar G. Okemwa; D.C.L.R. (Records) M. Kabiru; Director, Land Adjudication R. Oduya.
On the Pattern File: Maina's "Shosh said fix it" (99), Pius's "Tell her it's done" (96), and Mbithe's "from 4.12 (Records)" (98).
Supt. Koech's diary: "Call from Lands House, 4th floor (Records), re: Mwenda complaint. Instructed: close it." Two days after the complaint.
Joseph's working book, two months before his death: "Met Mrs. Kabiru, Records, 4.12, at her request re Block 9 amendment. Asked me to reconsider the line. Refused."
The FB 4471 withdrawal slip, J.E./SRO/0331: "on the authority of D.C.L.R. (Records)".
The amended survey of Block 9 is signed "J. Mwenda, Licensed Surveyor", dated five weeks after his death; approved "D.C.L.R. (Records), per M.K."
Rotich's letter (case 97): "The desk was Records."
Mbithe's note (case 98): "4.12 was Mrs. Kabiru's office." And: "Leah on the switchboard kept everything for her pension case."
Civil registry: Dr. Silas Mwangangi died eleven years ago, and the envelopes "via M." went on for nine more years. His office was on the fifth floor.
The Ministry gazette: twelve years ago that week Dr. Mwangangi was at a land conference in Arusha.
Fundi, in custody: "A desk. I told you in Kisumu. I didn't know it had a name." He repeats it: the Bahati road, the tyre lever, the wallet, the notebook handed into the car.
Pius, in custody: he drove GK A…094, waited in the car with Mr. Oduya in the back seat, and heard, "It's done. Tell her it's done."
Emojong, in custody: "The withdrawal was on Records' authority, through Adjudication. Her signature was on the authority slip. I kept your father's book."
Records ①: Margaret Kabiru booked Nairobi–London, one way, 09:15, at 22:31 last night, an hour after Maina's arrest. Her phone has been at JKIA since 07:40.
At 08:35 Amani detains Margaret Kabiru at Gate 14.
Lands House, fourth floor: 4.03 halfway down the corridor; 4.12 the corner office by the window.

Leave register: George Okemwa was on annual leave in Kisii for the whole month of the complaint and the killing.
The switchboard log: Leah's shift ended at 17:00 that day; she was signed out.
Records ②: since eleven years ago the Ukarimu Foundation Endowment has held 40% of Bahati Highlands Land Ltd, which sold Block 9's 60 plots: KSh 380 million in dividends.
On the back of the desk in Kabiru's study, a government asset tag: "Lands House — 4.12".
In the locked drawer, a carbon copy for the day Joseph died: "R. — Bahati tonight. He must stop. — K."
An older carbon in the same book: "Owino & Mwakazi — Registrar's seal, round — collect by driver. — K."
The verge where Joseph was found is a bus stop now.
Dr. Chebii, reviewing the original notes: one blow from a narrow steel bar; no defence injuries on the hands. Struck from behind, not in a struggle over a wallet.
The original post-mortem: death twelve years ago between 21:30 and 21:50.
Examiner Ayugi: the desk notebook is in the same hand as Kabiru's twelve-year-old Records memos.

interrogations.intro: Margaret Kabiru sits in her camel coat beside Senior Counsel Dorothy Wambugu, gloves folded in her lap. Once reopened: "4.12 was a shared line. Anyone could use it. And I never met a surveyor called Joseph Mwenda."
George Okemwa keeps both hands on his stick. "4.12 was a shared line for the whole Records section."
Leah holds a cardboard box on her lap and doesn't open it. "I kept no records. Switchboards don't."
Raphael Oduya agrees to one interview, his own counsel beside him. "The envelopes came from the Permanent Secretary, Dr. Mwangangi."
Fundi sits on the floor again. "A desk. I didn't know it had a name."
Pius folds his hands. "I drove. I have said it all."
Emojong cleans his glasses. "The withdrawal was on Records' authority, through Adjudication."
Mwalimu, on the phone, doesn't say hello. "Office 4.12. Go and get her before nine."

reconstruction.text: Twelve years ago Margaret Kabiru, Deputy Chief Land Registrar for Records, is buying into Bahati Highlands Land Ltd, which needs Block 9's survey amended. In office 4.12 she asks Joseph Mwenda to "reconsider the line". He refuses, and complains to the Nakuru police. Two days later 4.12 calls Nakuru: close it.

On the day he dies, at 14:10, 4.12 calls 4.03. That night Oduya, in GK A…094 driven by Pius, picks up a mechanic in Nakuru town. On the Bahati road Benedict Mbuvi strikes Joseph from behind with a tyre lever and takes his wallet and field book. Oduya calls: "It's done. Tell her it's done."

Five weeks later the amended survey is registered, signed "J. Mwenda". A year later FB 4471 is withdrawn on Records' authority. Kabiru retires, buys her old desk at the government auction, and from her study, through her foundation, her grandson and the till called Mvua, goes on.
An hour after Maina's arrest she books the 09:15 to London. At 08:35 Amani meets her at the gate.

afterVerdict.beat: The charge sheet is accepted. Amani signs it with Halima's father's fountain pen (case 90). The ink is blue-black. The signature is just "Amani".

files.text: Closed: the Ukarimu Foundation paid Till 880 214; Bahati Highlands Land Ltd paid the foundation.
Closed: the first forged registrar's seal was cut for "4th Floor, Lands House — Records", on a note signed "K.".
Closed: FB 4471 was withdrawn on the authority of D.C.L.R. (Records), office 4.12.
Closed: Fundi was paid by Raphael Oduya, carrying the order from 4.12.
Closed with the truth: Joseph Mwenda was killed by Benedict Mbuvi, with Raphael Oduya present and Pius Cheruiyot driving, on the orders of Margaret Kabiru. Not a robbery.
Identified: Kivuli is Margaret Kabiru, Deputy Chief Land Registrar (Records), office 4.12.

afterVerdict.beat: The epilogue strip, in silent cards: Mwalimu in a court corridor in her old uniform jacket; surveyors re-setting red beacons on Block 9 from Joseph's working book; thirty-seven files on a shelf in Isiolo; Hamisi holding his father's half-finished seal; one still from each place of the campaign; Halima putting a box of mandazi on Amani's desk.

The prologue's drawer. Amani types: "OB 01/05/12 — Reopened and closed. Joseph Mwenda, licensed surveyor, was killed on the Bahati road by Benedict Mbuvi, with Raphael Oduya present and Pius Cheruiyot driving, on the orders of Margaret Kabiru, Deputy Chief Land Registrar (Records), because he refused to move the beacons of Bahati Block 9. Not a robbery." CLOSED, in red. The folder is thick.
Mwalimu's last voice-note: "Close the drawer, Amani. Go home and sleep. He'd have been proud of how you did it. By the book." A new folder slides onto the corner of the desk, unopened: "OB 02/05/12."

clockPlan.note: In play the clock starts at 06:30 with Mwalimu's call and Halima pre-files records ① overnight, so the airline answers by 07:30 and the gate is reached before 08:45 (late: the flight is held at 08:50; no softlock, one star lost). Three stamps (the maximum). Detain Kabiru at the gate; handwriting (10 h) and paper (10 h) come back inside 24 h.

ui.beatNotes: The whole desk: every evidence store opens at once; the Pattern File's six threads draw into one line ending at office 4.12 and the six SPINE blanks fill from it. A timed first part (06:30 to 08:45) to reach the gate. The CLOSED stamp is red.
